title: CoNP-completeness of checking shortest bounded witnesses
claims: ShortestWitnessCheckingCoNPComplete constructs a polynomial-time verifier and length bound whose shortest-feasible-witness language is coNP-complete.
The reduction takes arbitrary raw SAT words to candidate pairs and uses the pinned SAT completeness theorem.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
